topics.title: STANLEY
topics.body:
STANLEY

STANLEY is a love letter to Michael Heilemann's Kubrick: the landmark WordPress theme that gave early blogging a recognisable home. It recreates the visual language, not the original code. The fixed white page, blue masthead, compact reading column and right sidebar have been rebuilt for SMACKTALK with responsive and accessibility support.

STANLEY 2024 honours KUBRICK 2024 by Rough Pixels, the contemporary reinterpretation that showed how Kubrick's visual lineage could move forward. SnapSmack uses neither theme's WordPress code; both developers are credited for the designs that inspired it.

Best Fit

Use STANLEY for a writing-led photoblog where posts, captions and longer stories matter as much as the photographs. It supports SMACKTALK longform posts and comments. It deliberately does not include the calendar tray, masonry view or carousel.

Choose Your Reality

  • STANLEY — THE OTHER SIDE is the faithful retro design. Roughly every half hour it may briefly glimpse STANLEY 2024 before returning.
  • STANLEY — Stable keeps the retro design fixed.
  • STANLEY 2024 — THE OTHER SIDE uses the modern design and may briefly glimpse retro STANLEY.
  • STANLEY 2024 — Stable keeps the modern design fixed.

The crossings are decorative, never change content or navigation, pause while the tab is hidden, and are disabled when the visitor requests reduced motion.

Crossing Test Mode is available under THE OTHER SIDE in Smooth Your Skin. Turn it on to perform one real crossing shortly after each page load, with any of the four variants. Turn it off again for normal timing.

STANLEY 2024 Hero Image opens the existing Asset Repository picker. If you have not selected one, STANLEY chooses the newest image already in your library the first time it renders, saves that choice, and keeps using it until you change it.

topics.title: Layout and Archive
topics.body:
Layout and Archive

  • Sidebar — shows site navigation, the site description and recent posts. Disable it in Smooth Your Skin for a single reading column.
  • Reading Column Width — controls the longform text width on desktop. The layout collapses automatically on tablets and phones.
  • Archive — uses each post's featured image as the thumbnail and links the thumbnail to the full post, not directly to the image.
  • Square / Cropped — choose uniform square thumbnails or aspect-aware crops. Cropped thumbnails are constrained between 2:3 and 3:2.

topics.title: Masthead and Colours
topics.body:
Masthead and Colours

The classic blue masthead is the default. In Smooth Your Skin you can replace it with a header photograph, replace the title with a logo, hide the tagline, or choose new top and bottom colours for the gradient.

Unvisited, visited, hover/focus and active links each have a separate colour control. Keeping a visible focus colour and reasonable contrast makes keyboard navigation easier to follow.
